- When player was at cols 33-34 and green block at cols 33-37, click worked

- When player was at cols 33-34 and green block at cols 43-47, click didn't work (this turn)

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Player at cols 33-34, green block at cols 43-47.
# Need to move RIGHT twice to align (33->38->43).
# Then click at (57, 45).

# Move RIGHT twice
action(['RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])

# Check player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
p_min_c = min(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
p_max_c = max(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
print(f"Player: cols {p_min_c}-{p_max_c}")

# Click on green block
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 57, 'col': 45}])

# Check result
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_blocks)}")

p_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']
w_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
p_pixels = p_nodes[0]['pixels'] if p_nodes else 0
w_pixels = w_nodes[0]['pixels'] if w_nodes else 0
print(f"Progress: {p_pixels}/{p_pixels+w_pixels}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
